description: This file contains utility functions for managing and detecting changes in extensions within a Git repository, including listing available extensions, detecting changed extensions, and resolving base revisions.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command with specified arguments and options, returning the output.

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Converts a file path to a normalized relative path with forward slashes.

methods.name: hasGitCommit
methods.description: Checks if a given git reference exists and is a commit.

methods.name: resolveChangedPathsBase
methods.description: Determines the base commit for detecting changed files, considering fallback options.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Lists file paths changed between a base commit and a head commit.

methods.name: hasExtensionPackage
methods.description: Checks if an extension package exists at a given extension ID.
